summary.text: Suhas Kulkarni is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Ken Fleming (R).
He won the May 19 Democratic primary with 72.1% of the vote and, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as an immigrant and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Kulkarni said in a Ballotpedia survey that he and his wife moved to the United States in 1986, in part for the special education their son needed, and began by running a small corner grocery store.
He said he founded the Office for Globalization in Louisville and has served on nonprofit boards including the World Affairs Council and the World Trade Center of Kentucky.
Kulkarni defeated Nathan Bellows, 4,170 votes to 1,613, in the 2026 Democratic primary.
His stated priorities include fully funding public schools with raises for teachers and school staff, protecting seniors, and supporting small businesses.
